description: Presets for repos that maintain cryostat-v* release branches. 'lockdown' disables all updates on release branches; call it first in extends. The default preset, release-branch.json(managerName), re-enables patch/pin/pinDigest updates for that manager on the current release branch. Update the matchBaseBranches value here whenever the active release branch changes.

packageRules.description: Disable all dependency updates on release branches by default; other updates there are handled via Mergify backport
Enable {{arg0}} updates on the current release branch so Renovate can classify update types
Restrict {{arg0}} updates on the current release branch to patch, pin, and pinDigest
